name: Arcane Shell
tagline: A wizard game where a motion-tracked Wii Remote is your wand.

awards: Best Bitcamp Game Jam Track Hack - Bitcamp

problem: Wizard games rely on buttons, not gestures.
solution: Gesture recognition on a motion-tracked controller casts spells in a first-person 3D game.
demo_moment: Team-described: draw a gesture to cast a spell.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Bitcamp Game Jam Track Hack - Bitcamp” among 223 submissions.
Reuses familiar hardware for a new purpose.

lessons: Old controllers make fresh game inputs.
